//! Test-only original production ASCII write observations; never synthesize expectations.
use super::*;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
type Snapshot = BTreeMap<String, String>;
fn snapshot(t: &TerminalState, previous_epoch: Option<u64>) -> Snapshot {
    let mut out = super::super::alternate_parity_tests::snapshot(t);
    out.insert(
        "search_scrollback_epoch_changed".into(),
        previous_epoch
            .is_some_and(|old| old != t.search_scrollback_epoch)
            .to_string(),
    );
    out.insert("dynamic_fg".into(), format!("{:?}", t.colors.dynamic_fg));
    out.insert("dynamic_bg".into(), format!("{:?}", t.colors.dynamic_bg));
    out.insert(
        "dynamic_cursor_color".into(),
        format!("{:?}", t.colors.dynamic_cursor_color),
    );
    out.insert(
        "dynamic_palette".into(),
        format!("{:?}", t.colors.dynamic_palette),
    );
    out.insert(
        "default_colors".into(),
        format!("{:?}", t.colors.default_colors),
    );
    out.insert(
        "window_title".into(),
        format!("{:?}", t.titles.window_title),
    );
    out.insert("icon_title".into(), format!("{:?}", t.titles.icon_title));
    out.insert("title_stack".into(), format!("{:?}", t.titles.title_stack));
    macro_rules! host {
        ($($f:ident),* $(,)?) => {$(out.insert(stringify!($f).into(), format!("{:?}", t.$f));)*};
    }
    host!(
        sync_output_active,
        current_working_dir,
        ime_enabled,
        preedit_text,
        preedit_cursor,
        host_window_focused,
        pending_osc52_clipboard_set,
        pending_osc52_clipboard_queries,
        pending_notifications,
        pending_bell,
        osc_reply_terminator,
        chat_pending_submit,
        chat_native_takeover_sequence,
        inline_cli_launch_floor,
        inline_cli_command_scope,
        next_projection_plan_revision
    );
    out.insert(
        "sync_start_present".into(),
        t.sync_output_start.is_some().to_string(),
    );
    out.insert("parser".into(), format!("{:?}", t.parser.snapshot()));
    out.insert(
        "kitty_image_count".into(),
        t.kitty_graphics.image_count().to_string(),
    );
    out.insert(
        "paste_grant".into(),
        format!(
            "{:?}",
            t.pending_paste_grant.as_ref().map(|g| (
                &g.token,
                g.offered_mimes
                    .iter()
                    .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>()
            ))
        ),
    );
    out.insert(
        "effective_default_background".into(),
        format!("{:?}", t.effective_default_background()),
    );
    out.insert(
        "color_scheme_report".into(),
        t.color_scheme_report().to_string(),
    );
    let records = t
        .command_records
        .iter()
        .cloned()
        .map(|mut r| {
            r.started_at = None;
            r.finished_at = None;
            r.started_instant = None;
            r.duration_ms = None;
            r
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    out.insert("commands".into(), format!("{records:?}"));
    let completed = t
        .pending_completed_command_outputs
        .iter()
        .cloned()
        .map(|mut e| {
            e.completed.duration_ms = None;
            e
        })
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    out.insert("completed".into(), format!("{completed:?}"));
    out
}
fn theme(light: bool) -> super::super::TerminalDefaultColors {
    super::super::TerminalDefaultColors {
        foreground: if light { (11, 22, 33) } else { (211, 222, 233) },
        background: if light { (240, 230, 220) } else { (10, 20, 30) },
        cursor: if light { (171, 182, 193) } else { (71, 82, 93) },
        ansi: std::array::from_fn(|i| {
            if light {
                (255 - i as u8 * 13, i as u8 * 11, 255 - i as u8 * 7)
            } else {
                (i as u8 * 13, 255 - i as u8 * 11, i as u8 * 7)
            }
        }),
    }
}
fn rich_seed(seed: usize) -> TerminalState {
    let mut t = super::super::alternate_parity_tests::seeded(seed);
    let now = std::time::Instant::now();
    t.sync_output_clock = super::super::SyncOutputClock::new(move || now);
    t.set_default_colors(theme(seed & 1 != 0));
    if seed & 1 != 0 {
        t.process_input(b"\x1b[?1049h");
    }
    if seed & 2 != 0 {
        t.process_input(b"\x1b[?2026h");
    }
    t.colors.dynamic_fg = Some((13, 24, 35));
    t.colors.dynamic_bg = Some((36, 47, 58));
    t.colors.dynamic_cursor_color = Some((59, 60, 71));
    t.colors.dynamic_palette = std::array::from_fn(|i| {
        if seed & 1 != 0 || i % 17 == 0 {
            Some((
                i as u8,
                (i as u8).wrapping_add(47),
                (i as u8).wrapping_add(93),
            ))
        } else {
            None
        }
    });
    t.titles.window_title = format!("seed window {seed}");
    t.titles.icon_title = format!("seed icon {seed}");
    t.titles.title_stack = match seed {
        0 => vec![],
        1 => vec![(Some("saved icon".into()), None)],
        2 => vec![(None, Some("saved window".into()))],
        _ => (0..16)
            .map(|i| (Some(format!("icon {i}")), Some(format!("window {i}"))))
            .collect(),
    };
    // Raw restored/seeded state bypasses OSC ingest on purpose: outbound
    // reportable_title has a different security policy from sanitized_title.
    if seed >= 2 {
        let poison = "\x1b\x07\u{0085}\u{061c}\u{202e}\u{2066}\u{200b}";
        let raw = format!("raw{poison}{}tail", "界".repeat(205));
        t.titles.window_title = format!("window {raw}");
        t.titles.icon_title = format!("icon {raw}");
        if seed == 2 {
            t.titles.title_stack = vec![(None, Some(format!("saved window {raw}")))];
        } else {
            t.titles.title_stack = (0..16)
                .map(|i| {
                    (
                        Some(format!("saved icon {i} {raw}")),
                        Some(format!("saved window {i} {raw}")),
                    )
                })
                .collect();
        }
    }
    t.preedit_text = "输入中".into();
    t.preedit_cursor = 1;
    t.pending_osc52_clipboard_set = Some("clipboard sentinel".into());
    t.pending_osc52_clipboard_queries.push_back(b"\x07");
    t.pending_notifications = vec![("title sentinel".into(), "body sentinel".into())];
    t.output_buffer = b"existing-reply".to_vec();
    t
}

#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
struct Profile {
    id: String,
    cols: usize,
    rows: usize,
}
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
struct Corpus {
    cases: Vec<Input>,
    profiles: Vec<Profile>,
    expected_record_count: usize,
}
#[derive(serde::Deserialize)]
struct Input {
    id: String,
    profiles: Option<Vec<String>>,
    setup_hex: String,
    feed_hex: String,
    snapshots_per_seed_profile: usize,
}
fn bytes(hex: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    assert!(hex.is_ascii() && hex.len() & 1 == 0);
    (0..hex.len())
        .step_by(2)
        .map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&hex[i..i + 2], 16).unwrap())
        .collect()
}
fn ends(n: usize, schedule: usize) -> Vec<usize> {
    if schedule == 0 {
        return vec![n];
    }
    if schedule == 1 {
        return (1..=n).collect();
    }
    let mut state = (schedule - 1) as u64;
    let mut at = 0;
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    while at < n {
        state ^= state << 13;
        state ^= state >> 7;
        state ^= state << 17;
        at = (at + 1 + (state % 23) as usize).min(n);
        out.push(at);
    }
    out
}
fn seeded(seed: usize, p: &Profile) -> TerminalState {
    let mut t = rich_seed(seed);
    // Resize through actual host behavior before measured inputs. Never leave
    // stale6x5 region/cursor indices in a one-column/one-row geometry.
    t.on_resize(p.cols, p.rows);
    t.process_input(b"\x1b[?6l\x1b[r\x1b(B\x0f\x1b[4l\x1b[?7h\x1b[1;1H");
    t.set_max_scrollback(3);
    t.process_input(b"history0\r\nhistory1\r\nhistory2\r\nhistory3\r\nhistory4\r\nhistory5\r\n");
    // New active output anchors are established at the actual resized grid.
    t.process_input(b"\x1b[1;1H\x1b]133;A\x07\x1b]133;C;id=ascii-seeded\x07");
    if seed & 1 != 0 {
        t.process_input(b"\x1b[1;65535HX");
    }
    t.output_buffer = b"existing-reply".to_vec();
    assert_eq!(t.screen.grid.row_len(), p.cols);
    assert_eq!(t.screen.grid.rows(), p.rows);
    assert!(t.screen.cursor_col < p.cols && t.screen.cursor_row < p.rows);
    assert!(t.screen.scroll_region_top <= t.screen.scroll_region_bottom);
    assert!(t.screen.scroll_region_bottom < p.rows);
    assert_eq!(t.screen.active_charset, Charset::Ascii);
    assert!(!t.screen.insert_mode);
    assert_eq!(t.screen.use_alt_buffer, seed & 1 != 0);
    assert_eq!(t.sync_output_active, seed & 2 != 0);
    super::super::structural_parity_tests::prime(&mut t);
    t
}
fn for_each_case(mut visit: impl FnMut(String, Snapshot)) {
    let corpus: Corpus =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../tests/fixtures/ascii_corpus.json")).unwrap();
    let mut seen = 0;
    for p in &corpus.profiles {
        for seed in 0..4 {
            visit(
                format!("{}_seed_{seed}", p.id),
                snapshot(&seeded(seed, p), None),
            );
            seen += 1;
            for input in &corpus.cases {
                if input
                    .profiles
                    .as_ref()
                    .is_some_and(|ps| !ps.contains(&p.id))
                {
                    continue;
                }
                let mut count = 0;
                for schedule in 0..6 {
                    let mut t = seeded(seed, p);
                    let epoch = t.search_scrollback_epoch;
                    t.process_input(&bytes(&input.setup_hex));
                    if input.id == "awm_l_pending" {
                        assert!(
                            t.screen.pending_wrap,
                            "DECAWM-off case must start with true latch"
                        );
                        assert!(!t.protocol.modes().contains(&7));
                        assert_eq!(t.screen.cursor_col, p.cols - 1);
                    }

                    visit(
                        format!(
                            "{}_seed_{seed}_{}_partition_{schedule}_setup",
                            p.id, input.id
                        ),
                        snapshot(&t, Some(epoch)),
                    );
                    count += 1;

                    if input.id == "initial_wrap_provenance" && !t.screen.use_alt_buffer {
                        let active = t
                            .active_output_provenance
                            .expect("active initial-wrap output");
                        assert!(t.screen.pending_wrap);
                        assert!(!active.invalid);
                        assert_eq!(
                            active.start_row_id,
                            t.screen.grid.row_id(t.screen.cursor_row)
                        );
                        assert!(active.extent.is_none() && active.last_write_end.is_none());
                    }
                    let scrolled_before = t.total_lines_scrolled;
                    let data = bytes(&input.feed_hex);
                    let mut start = 0;
                    for (feed, end) in ends(data.len(), schedule).into_iter().enumerate() {
                        let epoch = t.search_scrollback_epoch;
                        t.process_input(&data[start..end]);
                        start = end;
                        visit(
                            format!(
                                "{}_seed_{seed}_{}_partition_{schedule}_feed_{feed}",
                                p.id, input.id
                            ),
                            snapshot(&t, Some(epoch)),
                        );
                        count += 1;
                    }
                    assert_eq!(start, data.len());
                    if input.id.starts_with("eviction_") && !t.screen.use_alt_buffer {
                        assert!(t.total_lines_scrolled.saturating_sub(scrolled_before) > 3);
                        assert_eq!(t.scrollback.len(), 3, "bounded history must actually evict");
                    }
                }
                assert_eq!(count, input.snapshots_per_seed_profile);
                seen += count;
            }
        }
    }
    assert_eq!(seen, corpus.expected_record_count);
}
#[test]
#[ignore = "explicit original production capture, no candidate expectations"]
fn print_ascii_baseline() {
    for_each_case(|key, state| {
        println!(
            "\nASCII_BASELINE\t{}",
            serde_json::to_string(&(key, state)).unwrap()
        )
    });
}

#[test]
fn ascii_seed_geometry_invariants() {
    let corpus: Corpus =
        serde_json::from_str(include_str!("../../tests/fixtures/ascii_corpus.json")).unwrap();
    for p in &corpus.profiles {
        for seed in 0..4 {
            let t = seeded(seed, p);
            assert_eq!(t.screen.pending_wrap, seed & 1 != 0);
            assert_eq!(t.max_scrollback, 3);
            // Published ScreenState::resize_geometry resizes both stores and
            // clamps alternate cursors; the6x5 no-op seed already has both6x5.
            assert_eq!(t.screen.alt_grid.rows(), p.rows, "hidden rows {}", p.id);
            assert_eq!(t.screen.alt_grid.row_len(), p.cols, "hidden cols {}", p.id);
            assert!(t.screen.alt_cursor_row < t.screen.alt_grid.rows());
            assert!(t.screen.alt_cursor_col < t.screen.alt_grid.row_len());
            if !t.screen.use_alt_buffer {
                assert!(!t.scrollback.is_empty(), "primary history {}", p.id);
                assert!(t.scrollback.len() <= t.max_scrollback);
                let active = t.active_output_provenance.expect("primary active output");
                assert!(!active.invalid, "valid primary provenance {}", p.id);
                assert_eq!(
                    active.start_row_id,
                    t.screen.grid.row_id(t.screen.cursor_row)
                );
                assert!(active.extent.is_none() && active.last_write_end.is_none());
            }
        }
    }
}
